reference:
The Irish Parliamentary Party was formed in 1874 by Isaac Butt, replacing the Home Rule League, as the official parliamentary party for Irish nationalist Members of Parliament (MPs) elected to the House of Commons at Westminster within the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland up until 1918. Its central objectives were legislative independence for Ireland and land reform, and it was instrumental in laying the groundwork for Irish self-government through three Irish Home Rule bills.

FINDING: The Irish Parliamentary Party campaigned for the Irish Home Rule Movement.
